profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, and traded under the ticker SOUN. Its website describes its OASYS platform as powering voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The company describes its approach as agentic AI aimed at customer-facing voice interactions, and the site quotes customers saying the technology resolves requests faster, helps franchisees take orders more efficiently during peak hours, and supports always-on voice experiences through hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity.

The corporate record adds that SoundHound AI is a for-profit public company with CIK 0001840856. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Delaware, with 33 entries.
